subject: exp-dy
title: EXP.DY.-----POL.P.
description: Diagram closing MP(II)-32 — the section on world politics at the close of the seventies and how western political functionalism has expanded western culture's material/geographical reality while 'progressively crushing the life options of composite world culture.' The prose directly above identifies the structural object the diagram captures: 'the nature underlying how these various progressions have actualized is indeed related to the realness of politics, and this concerns the whole of humanity.' The crossing diagrams how exposure-dynamics meets political-particulars: EXP-DY (exposure dynamics — how the form / region / phenomenon actually appears in the world) is crossed with POL-P (political particulars — the political conditions that gate which exposures count). EXP-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; INFO-DY (information dynamics) drops below it and C-INFO (central information) anchors the bottom-center as the subject's downward outputs. JR-DYM (junior dynamism) rises above as the subject's upper bridge to PART (participation) and SOC-RT (social reality), with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) on the upper-right and CULT-TF-S (cultural-transfer-source) feeding down into TRS (transformation) at the right margin. POL-P sits centrally as partner-axis; EXT-FT (extended functionalism) hangs below as the partner's downward output. Structural argument: the upper chain JR-DYM → PART → SOC-RT → PROG-CONT is the *world-information question* the prose names — the route by which exposure-dynamics, junior-dynamism, and participation reach the partner-axis's progressional-continuance. CULT-TF-S → TRS on the right is the cultural-transfer-into-transformation route the partner needs. But the diagram's load-bearing structural claim is that POL-P routes downward into EXT-FT alone — political-particulars produces extended-functionalism on the partner side, and that extended-functionalism is exactly what 'expands the material and geographical reality of western culture.' The lower subject chain INFO-DY → C-INFO terminates without crossing back to the partner; the diagonal that would let central-information meet extended-functionalism on the partner-side is what the next-cycle ecological awareness the next section names structurally requires. Without it, world information-dynamics never reaches political-particulars as the kind of input that could change extended-functionalism's course.
